basic_info.description: Step into a rare opportunity to own one of the most desirable and largest floor plan at 101 Lombard. This northeast-facing corner treasure offers breathtaking, iconic views of the Bay, the Bridge, and the City, perfect for discerning buyers seeking generous space, stunning panoramas, and a seamless, luxurious lifestyle. Revel in views from every room, along with two spacious decksone off the living room and another accessible from both the second and primary bedrooms. The third bedroom/office provides personal flexibility. The expansive living room features an impressive marble, floor-to-ceiling wood-burning fireplace. All doors have been extended to 9 foot ceiling heights, and the home is equipped with abundant custom closets and storage throughout. Enjoy meals in a formal dining area, highlighted by a bay window with spectacular views from three sides and a built-in window seat. The large kitchen is exquisite, showcasing high-quality finishes. Additional conveniences include deeded parking, a 24-hour concierge, and excellent amenities such as a heated pool and hot tub, creating a perfect blend of luxury and convenience. With its prime location and rare combination of features, this condo offers an incredible opportunity to experience the best of San Francisco living.
